title: Fixed Universal Transformers
summary: A fixed-weights universal-transformer view is both architecturally foundational and unusually paradigm-shifting, making it broadly important beyond a niche reading list.

metadata.comment: Shows fixed transformers can be universal simulators of transformer classes via suitable input embeddings, including generic universality of random transformers.
metadata.spotlight_comment: A fixed-weights universal-transformer view is both architecturally foundational and unusually paradigm-shifting, making it broadly important beyond a niche reading list.

title: Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding
summary: The paper opens a potentially important direction for BP-like learning via purely local dynamics, with implications for alternative training mechanisms and theory.

metadata.comment: Adds layer-local Lagrange multipliers to predictive coding so local updates converge to backprop-equivalent gradients in linear networks.
metadata.spotlight_comment: The paper opens a potentially important direction for BP-like learning via purely local dynamics, with implications for alternative training mechanisms and theory.

title: Neuro-symbolic Syntactic Parsing: Shaping a Neural Network with the CYK Algorithm
summary: It points toward a new architectural paradigm of directly embedding classical algorithms into trainable neural dynamics rather than only learning them implicitly.

metadata.comment: Injects the CYK parsing algorithm directly into a recurrent neural architecture via trainable matrix-vector operations.
metadata.spotlight_comment: It points toward a new architectural paradigm of directly embedding classical algorithms into trainable neural dynamics rather than only learning them implicitly.

title: Improving Relative Representations with Learned Anchors and Whitened Inner Products
summary: The work suggests a potentially new direction for modular cross-model communication through shared relative latent geometry rather than direct parameter or token-level alignment.

metadata.comment: Improves relative representations for cross-model communication via learned semantic anchors and whitened geometry-aware similarity.
metadata.spotlight_comment: The work suggests a potentially new direction for modular cross-model communication through shared relative latent geometry rather than direct parameter or token-level alignment.

title: The Terminal Representation in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Broadly important today: Introduces the terminal representation, a lower-dimensional reward-weighted RL representation that recovers DR-like structure without eigendecomposition.

metadata.comment: Introduces the terminal representation, a lower-dimensional reward-weighted RL representation that recovers DR-like structure without eigendecomposition.

title: On the Relationship Between Activation Outliers and Feature Death in Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Broadly important today: Identifies activation-mean outliers as the cause of SAE feature death and shows mean-centering eliminates the problem across many model families.
